security_boundary: The package supplies behavioral instructions for ordinary unauthenticated public web, reader, browser, API, explorer, dashboard and bounded RPC research, not an enforced sandbox. Public reads within existing host permissions require no custom broker, tool certification or per-source administrator approval. Use an unauthenticated browser context without wallet providers, extensions or sessions, privileged access, or signing/broadcast paths; a normal browser's general ability to click does not prohibit public reading. No wallet interaction, signing, transaction preparation or submission, state-changing-method simulation, private-context egress, credential access, private/local/metadata destinations, source-driven execution or permission broadening is allowed. ABI query encoding is permitted solely for read-only eth_call. Optional external isolation, brokers and denial tests support enforcement claims only when actually implemented and tested; no such guarantee follows from loading this skill or from the historical evidence. Missing broker tests limit claims, not safe public browsing. Offline knowledge is an optional first smoke profile or fallback when acceptable public-read access is unavailable.
